players.bio: Adam Uche Idah ( EE-dah; born 11 February 2001) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Swansea City and the Republic of Ireland national team.
Andrew Lee Fisher (born 12 February 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Swansea City.
Benjamin George Cabango (born 30 May 2000) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Swansea City, which he captains, and the Wales national team.
Ben Nicholas Lloyd (born 14 March 2005) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL Championship club Swansea City. He is a Wales under-21 international.

Cameron Robert Burgess (born 21 October 1995) is a professional soccer player who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Swansea City. Born in Scotland, he represents the Australia national team.

Elijah Henry Just (born 1 May 2000) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for EFL Championship club Swansea City and the New Zealand national team. A full international for New Zealand since 2019, Just became the country's all-time leading scorer at the FIFA World Cup after scoring three goals in the 2026 tournament.

Filip Augustus Lissah (born 8 December 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Swansea City. Born in England, he has represented the Czech Republic at youth level.
Gonçalo Batista Franco (born 17 November 2000) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Swansea City.

Jay Fulton (born 1 April 1994) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Swansea City. He previously played for Falkirk, and spent time with Oldham Athletic and Wigan Athletic on loan from Swansea. He represented Scotland at international youth levels up to under-21s.
Jenson Danluca Seelt (born 23 May 2003) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Swansea City, on loan from Premier League club Sunderland.
Jeremy Ngola Monga (born 10 July 2009) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Swansea City, on loan from Premier League club Manchester City.
Eom Ji-sung (Korean: 엄지성; born 9 May 2002) is a South Korean footballer currently playing as a winger for EFL Championship club Swansea City and the South Korea national team.
Joseph Amankwaah Opoku (born 8 August 2005) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Swansea City and the Ghana national team.

Joshua Lewis Tymon (born 22 May 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Swansea City. Tymon began his career with his local club Hull City before joining Stoke City in July 2017 following the Tigers' relegation in 2016–17. He spent time on loan at Milton Keynes Dons in 2017–18.
Joshua Myles Abraham Key (born 19 November 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Swansea City.

Lawrence Ian Vigouroux (born 19 November 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Swansea City. Born in England, Vigouroux has represented Chile as a youth international level. Born in Camden, England, Vigouroux started his football education within the youth set-up at Brentford.

Marko Seufatu Nikola Stamenić (Serbian Cyrillic: Марко Сеуфату Никола Стаменић; born 19 February 2002) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Swansea City and the New Zealand national team.
Viktor Melker Widell (born 19 April 2002) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays either in central midfield or as a winger for EFL Championship club Swansea City.
Moussa Kounfolo Yeo (born 1 June 2004) is a Malian football player who plays as a midfielder for the EFL Championship club Swansea City.

Paul David Appleby Farman (born 2 November 1989) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Swansea City. Farman started playing first-team football for Blyth Spartans of the Conference North during the 2008–09 season. Prior to making his debut for Blyth, he was loaned out to Washington in order to gain first-team experience.
Ronald Pereira Martins (born 14 June 2001), simply known as Ronald, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Swansea City.

Ross Cameron Stewart (born 11 July 1996) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Swansea City and the Scotland national team. Stewart is a graduate from the Motherwell youth system, and was in direct competition with regular number 2 Lee Hollis for a place on the bench during the 2012–13 season.

Stephen Welsh is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Swansea City. Welsh began his career in the youth sides at Celtic, stepping up to their development side in 2017, and in March 2018, signed a contract with the club until 2020. Alongside fixtures in the SPFL Development League, he featured for the team in the Scottish Challenge Cup.
Thomas Achi Iorpenda (born 6 April 2005) is an English footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Swansea City.

Vítor Emanuel Soares Matos (born 28 March 1988) is a Portuguese football manager who is the head coach of EFL Championship club Swansea City. Matos began his career coaching youth teams in Portugal, including at Porto. After two years coaching at Shandong Luneng in China, he returned to Porto before joining Premier League club Liverpool as an elite development coach under Jürgen Klopp in 2019.
Žan Vipotnik (born 18 March 2002) is a Slovenian professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Swansea City and the Slovenia national team.
